main_caution: DoubleML checks shape and execution, not causal validity.
The split must match the data design; random folds are not always appropriate.
Predictions must be cross-fitted, row-aligned, and shaped as (n_obs, n_rep).
Model diagnostics are not causal evidence.
Score diagnostics can reveal instability but do not replace identification assumptions.
Low predictive loss is helpful but not sufficient for causal credibility.
